topic: 递归处理理论（Recurrent Processing Theory, RPT）

sources.citation: Lamme VA, Roelfsema PR. The distinct modes of vision offered by feedforward and recurrent processing. Trends Neurosci. 2000 Nov;23(11):571-9.
sources.usage: 奠基性理论综述：前馈与递归两种视觉处理模式的区分；RPT 理论框架的主要来源
sources.notes: 只读摘要；Trends in Neuroscience 综述，高被引（>5000次）

sources.citation: Lamme VA, Zipser K, Spekreijse H. Figure-ground activity in primary visual cortex is suppressed by anesthesia. Proc Natl Acad Sci USA. 1998 Mar 17;95(6):3263-8.
sources.usage: 关键实验：麻醉消除 V1 图像-背景分离信号，保留前馈响应；RPT 核心证据之一
sources.notes: 猕猴在体电生理；开放全文 PMC 已读

sources.citation: Lamme VA, Zipser K, Spekreijse H. Masking interrupts figure-ground signals in V1. J Cogn Neurosci. 2002 Oct 1;14(7):1044-53.
sources.usage: 掩蔽实验：视觉掩蔽精确对应 V1 图像-背景信号消失与主观不可见；RPT 核心证据之一

sources.citation: Supèr H, van der Togt C, Spekreijse H, Lamme VA. Internal State of Monkey Primary Visual Cortex (V1) Predicts Figure-Ground Perception. J Neurosci. 2003 Apr 15;23(8):3407-3414.
sources.usage: V1 刺激前内部状态（神经元同步性）预测图像检测成功率；RPT 递归网络基线状态作用的证据
sources.notes: 猕猴在体电生理；开放全文 PMC 已读

sources.citation: Lamme VA. Towards a true neural stance on consciousness. Trends Cogn Sci. 2006 Nov;10(11):494-501.
sources.usage: 方法论立场：神经证据与行为报告同等权重；RPT 从相关理论升级为神经定义理论的论证

sources.citation: Lamme VA. Challenges for theories of consciousness: seeing or knowing, the missing ingredient and how to deal with panpsychism. Philos Trans R Soc Lond B Biol Sci. 2018 Sep 19;373(1755):20170344.
sources.usage: 缺失要素问题（NMDA 依赖的网络可塑性）；seeing vs knowing 分歧；对 GWT/IIT 的批评
sources.notes: 开放全文 PMC 已读

sources.citation: Lamme VA. Visual Functions Generating Conscious Seeing. Front Psychol. 2020 Feb 14;11:83.
sources.usage: 最新四阶段视觉意识模型；感知觉组织作为意识的关键运算；RPT 与 GWT/IIT/HOT 的对比
sources.notes: 开放全文 PMC 已读；2020 年最新综述

sources.citation: Tsuchiya N, Wilke M, Frässle S, Lamme VA. No-Report Paradigms: Extracting the True Neural Correlates of Consciousness. Trends Cogn Sci. 2015 Dec;19(12):757-770.
sources.usage: 无报告范式理论框架；如何区分报告相关神经活动与意识相关神经活动

sources.citation: Allen C, Viola T, Irvine E, Sedgmond J, Castle H, Gray R, Chambers CD. Causal manipulation of feed-forward and recurrent processing differentially affects measures of consciousness. Neurosci Conscious. 2020;2020(1):niaa015.
sources.usage: 对 RPT 简化版的挑战：早期 TMS（前馈期）比晚期 TMS 更大破坏意识；前馈/递归区分可能更好对应感知/报告
